function.name: sitefinity_create_contentitem
function.description: Create a new content item in Sitefinity CMS with specified metadata for SEO optimization and a unique URL name. Ensures that content is visible and well-represented in search engine results. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Title.description: The title of the content item. It is displayed prominently on the page and used as the clickable link on search engine results pages.

Content.description: The body content of the content item. Contains the main text of the content and can include HTML tags.

MetaTitle.description: The HTML meta title for SEO. Should be concise and relevant to the content topic. If not provided, the 'Title' will be used.

MetaDescription.description: The HTML meta description for SEO. Provides a brief summary of the content and its relevance. If not provided, a summary derived from the 'Content' will be used.

UrlName.description: A human-readable and SEO-friendly URL slug for the content item. It is typically constructed using hyphens to separate words and should be unique.

4. **Meta description** – If you’d like a custom meta description, please provide it; otherwise I can generate one from the content (which will be empty in this case).

Once I have those, I can create the item for you.
